title: NASA unveils X-70 Fractal experimental aircraft
excerpt: The crewed research platform is designed for testing advanced aviation technologies and flight-control systems.
bodyHtml:
NASA announced the X-70 Fractal experimental aircraft on November 4, 2026, during the UP.Summit at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The agency described the vehicle as a high-performance, crewed research platform capable of testing advanced flight-control and maneuverability technologies.

The X-70 Fractal features a modular design that allows for the rapid reconfiguration of internal and external payloads up to 2,000 pounds. The aircraft has a takeoff weight of 10,000 pounds, a cruise speed of Mach .75, and an operational range exceeding 1,500 nautical miles.

The aircraft is designed to reach altitudes of up to 45,000 feet. NASA expects the first flight of the X-70 under the agency's banner to occur within two years.
topic: NASA Announces X-70 Experimental Aircraft to Advance Flight Research
